verdict.rationale: Gecko's v1 API documents that users can 'manage scan schedules', which implies recurring security scans are a first-party capability. That is the only mention, so cadence options, UI scheduling, and scheduling of workflows beyond scans are unevidenced. The daily GitLab token check is internal vendor behavior, not a user-defined schedule. Missing for 10: dedicated scheduling docs (cadence/cron options, UI configuration), recurring workflows beyond scans, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Gecko's v1 API lets you trigger scans, read scan, repository, and vulnerability data, triage findings, manage scan schedules
